summary: The stage failure probe tripped because implementation runs fail at their first model request. The logs point at the broker refusing their tokens.

findings.title: Implementation stage runs fail since the broker restart

observations.observed: Four of the last six implementation stage runs in the hour ended with outcome failed, a share of 0.67 against a threshold of 0.25.
From 09:02 UTC the worker logged 14 lines with error.type budget_refused for the implementation stage and none before.
No lease is past its expiry and no stage run is past its deadline, so the failures end quickly rather than hang.

findings.hypothesis: The broker refuses the run tokens of the implementation stage since about 09:00 UTC, so each attempt fails at its first model request. A ceiling that is lower than one attempt needs would look like this.
next_checks: Compare the per stage run ceiling of the builder role in the routing policy with the spend of the last passed implementation run.
Read the broker log lines around 09:00 UTC for the reason it gives for each refusal.
